title: For immersions of algebraic spaces, Koszul-regular implies H1-regular implies quasi-regular
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the lemma records the implication chain: i Koszul-regular implies i H1-regular implies i quasi-regular. The retained proof is written: via the definitions (both regularity notions for immersions of spaces are checked etale-locally by the corresponding notions for the immersions of scheme charts) the lemma immediately reduces to Divisors, lemma regular-quasi-regular-immersion for immersions of schemes, quoted by name; no space-specific argument beyond the definitional transfer is added. Retained author proof at lines 10559-10562.
